svg.title: where c > 0 is the direct clip coefficient, so the full Gram factor is the stack (√c I, F). Both metrics are symmetric with quadratic forms between η(J(i))I and Ω(J(i))I, η > 0, and the terminal unamended metric is I. Each transition carries a fine potential response A0, a curvature response T, and mixed, normal and image rows satisfying the stationary and Gram identities derived in the following subsections. The mixed row has bound Ω/L2; the normal and image rows have bound Ω.
